name: skeleton
description: A placeholder that breathes only while it is on screen. Reduced motion is a static bar. TalkBack skips it.
avoidWhen: Do not use as a spinner on a button. Do not leave it on screen after content arrives.

ux.behaviour: A quiet bar fills the space content will occupy; TalkBack skips it
ux.why: A placeholder should not be a conversation

ux.behaviour: The pulse stops when the item leaves the composition
ux.why: Off-screen motion is waste and jank

aiHints: Replace the skeleton with content; do not stack both
Pass height when the slot is not a text line
